test: Hucking alley: hucks in the lane
description: Skill test: throwing range and accuracy
instructions: 10 hucks (5 backhand, 5 forehand) down a 20 m-wide lane marked with cones every 10 m. Count the hucks that land in the lane past 30 m. Throw the same way each round and note the wind.

test: Hucking alley: longest huck in the lane
instructions: The distance of your longest huck that landed in the lane, to the nearest 5 m.
10 break throws past an active marker forcing forehand, to a static receiver 10-15 m away on the break side. Stall 6. A completion is a throw the receiver catches without moving more than one step.
As the forehand-force test, with the marker forcing backhand. A confident break thrower scores 8 or more on both.

From a stack spot 15 m from the thrower, get open before stall 6 against a defender starting on your back shoulder. 10 reps: 5 under, 5 deep or away. Count clean catches. Defenders are 1s players at full intensity.
20 catches in the heads-on drill at full speed. Count clean catches.

description: Athletic profile: change of direction. Recorded, not counted in the skill goal.
instructions: Three cones 5 m apart. Start at the middle cone, go 5 m one way, 10 m back, 5 m to finish. One attempt starting each way. Film it and time from first movement to the line. Same surface and shoes each round.
Standing start behind the line; full recovery between attempts. Film from the side with cones at 5, 10, 35 and 50 m, and time from first movement.
